text:
Aisha - CS: Quick capture from today's renewal check-in with Meridian Health. They raised three product asks that could impact renewal. Please triage.
Tom - PM: Thanks. Keep each ask one sentence + fields: customer, summary, outcome, cadence, severity, renewal_risk (yes/no). We'll assign P0/P1/P2 and an estimate after triage.
Priya - CS: Notes from call:
- Detailed route billing export: need per-route + model breakdown for 60d to reconcile chargebacks (urgent for finance)
- Streamlined infra onboarding: error during key rotation blocked deploys -> they want a guided script to finish in <15min
- Console control for embedding lifecycle (dedupe + retention): duplicates after periodic imports affect search freshness
Tom - PM: Proposed CSV template to paste into the ticket:
customer,summary,expected_outcome,frequency,severity,renewal_risk,priority,estimate,notes
Meridian,Route billing export,60d per-route+model export,daily,high,yes,P0,M,Finance requires before renewal conversation
Meridian,Infra onboarding script,<15min infra setup,one-off,medium,no,P1,S,Include key rotation steps and env var checklist
Meridian,Embedding lifecycle UI,control dedupe+retention,intermittent,medium,no,P2,M,Request sample import + logs
Riley - Eng: For 60d export we can do daily aggregates from logs; estimate Medium (2 dev days). If sampling acceptable we can S.
Aisha - CS: I'll ask if finance will accept sampling and request a 50-row sample CSV + import log for the dedupe issue.
OpsBot: Imported Intercom thread: "Meridian: duplicates after nightly import, searching returns stale results"
Tom - PM: Scheduling 30-min triage tomorrow 9am PT with Riley + Aisha. After triage we'll set priorities and owners. Thanks all :thumbsup:
